notes.title: 0.14.4b Spellblade
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

The wait is over! Our new hero class, Spellblade, is now playable in the main game. Blast your enemies with powerful weapon and unique skills – all the details are in the Patch notes below.


[h3]Steam Trading Cards [/h3]
We hear you! Steam Trading Cards and Collectible items are in the works. Get ready to expand your collection soon.

[h3]Spellblade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/ea7edf55bafb02bc8bfa3dbb494548ee984d9c54.png[/img]
A swordsman adept in the art of enchanted weaponry, channeling their arcane prowess to deliver a relentless onslaught of magical strikes upon their adversaries.
Her unique passive skill is Energy burst,  Unleash lightning to attack nearby enemies, when energy is restored. Damage scale with hero level

[h3]Heavenly sword[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/3cd645a08af4d0c347f8b4b224242eed6cb724ab.png[/img]
Legendary sword that unleashes a potent light attack upon its foes, inflicts continuous damage upon any foes unfortunate enough to find themselves within its radiant path.

You can unlock the new hero by completing a new achievement, Survive "The Second Cycle" for 15 mins.
(You can find the detail about the second cycle here, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2027970/view/3689062938637787162]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2027970/view/3689062938637787162[/url] )

notes.title: Update 0.13.1b Kamabhumi
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone[/h3]
Now, our new stage "Kamabhumi", the land of spirits and giants, is now available for everyone to play in the main game version.
We have added more details to the images and sounds from the beta version. We have also made some adjustments to the data and added a new boss rush mode and achievements to collect.

The difficulty of has been reserved for some new features that will be added in the future. However, we believe it will not be too difficult for everyone!

Also, we have reset the leaderboard for the boss rush mode entirely. This is because we have made some significant balance changes to the game, and we have also fixed some important bugs.

notes.title: Content update reveal
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]
It's been a while, and we wanted to update you on the progress of our next content update. We're excited to announce that we're working on new Biomes and will be released soon.


[h3]The Realm of spirit[/h3]
Inspired by the seven realms of spirits from our homeland culture, the new biomes introduce a realm where you can encounter angels, evil spirits, and giants living together.
[previewyoutube=VQVbtiXU9Yg;full][/previewyoutube]


Following the introduction of the new biomes, we will continue to add new heroes as planned. The next hero will be the Venomer, who will also introduce the new status system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/ffe59466a5b89cbb711406b9a85e7553171bdf80.jpg[/img]

As a two-person team committed to creating our game with original assets, updates may not be released as quickly as we would like.

If you are enjoying the game and like what we're doing, you could help us by leaving some good  review for the game. It'd be a huge help!

If you have any suggestion or feedback,  Please join our Discord channel below.

notes.title: 0.12.9a - Critical hit damage
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone, [/h3]
Sorry to keep you waiting, it's been a while since the latest character update, This update bring you "critical hit" system and remove some unused  hero stat.
This update may seem like it doesn't change much, but we've made some fundamental changes to the game's code to prepare for new systems that will be added in the future, If you find some unexpected behavior please let us know.

[h3]Critical Hit[/h3]
Every heroes now has 5% Critical rate, Critical hit deal 110% of the weapon max damage.
You can upgrade critical rate and damage at the meta progression upgrade at the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/d0cd6b3b7f911f2ada8685121fa591cfe2c98db1.png[/img]
[h3]Balance Change[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced Max damage upgrade by 5%
[*] Nerfed : "Eye of the blacksmith" now increase min damage from 15% - 60% 
[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pierecing, Critical Damage and Critical rate now show on the status menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.12.7b - "The Second Cycle" on main version
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Sole Survivors[/h3]
In this new patch, we have updated the "Second Circle" for the main version and added new features to make the game even more complete.

[h3]Enemy HP bar[/h3]
In the second circle, Most of the enemies have more health bonus, This can lead to frustration due to lack of the crutial information. To improve the gaming experience, we have added health bars to regular enemies. You can disable health bars in the settings menu if you prefer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/488127f4c1517b76daa32ad2b19c095ec6cb5e97.png[/img]

[h3]Soul Collector[/h3]
Enemies have a chance to drop "Soul Collector", which will collect all dropped souls for you when pick it up.

[h3]The Second Cycle[/h3]
Once you have completed a stage, you can choose to play the "Second Circle". This option is unlocked by completing the "Chaos 3" level of the map.

The "Second Circle" will reset the stage timer and increase the challenge level in the following ways:
[list]
[*] Enemies have more health and damage.
[*] Enemies spawn more frequently.
[*] Battle two bosses at the same time
[*]Higher-level enemies will appear more often, also have a chance to drop gold, experience, or helpful items.
[/list]
The "Second Circle" is a great way to test your skills and earn some more gold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/49bc52aa2362859c4e5027a2510a47f85acf520a.jpg[/img]

The balance is still under adjustment and some helper item and upgrade will be added later, Please consider it as the feature that challenge your skills and keep you busy while we develop the new content. If you have any suggestions, join the official discord channel below.
[url=https://discord.gg/pqsqYTqPd7]Discord[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2027970/discussions/]Dissustions[/url]

notes.title: Early Access content preview
notes.content:
Hello~!
We are really excited about the game release and would love to share some of the main Early Access Content informations

[b]Weapon Type[/b]
There are 3 weapon types in Sole Saga
[olist]
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/553df8f83b04d9c8c6c2817e2183eca03d45bcd6.png[/img] Standard weapon, main auto attack weapons with a variety of attacks.
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/273ac7d602bf0406c937b065bc472a0b122c90c1.png[/img] Secret weapon, fired when dodge-rolls, Giving you more control over the weapon
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/9912c9f16e878a1e0e46f9075ce72000ab296e25.png[/img] Magic weapon, A powerful weapon that takes time to summon. 
[/olist]
[b]Goddess Totem[/b]
During to run, you will find a totem that required you to stain certain number of enemy or some gold.
These totems will summon the Goddess of Creation, she will offer you some special upgrade, gold or you could spend some gold to make her imbue a weapon for you, but be careful with your gold , you would need it for a meta progression upgrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/fea95a7c3b08a579a19918c46069acbe8b28b9b9.jpg[/img]

[b]Imbued Weapon[/b]
All weapons can be "imbued" with the specific relic to unlock their new abilities.
The imbued weapon ability could be upgrade by "upgrading the relics" which is tied to the weapon. 
You can see all equipped weapons stats at the pause view in the game by navigate to the equipped slot. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/7d1b6237eef47a9296ee1143a9d1671753ed4dde.png[/img]

[b]Field's relics[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662695/1565d2a64cc6011b578c58006706632884320a58.jpg[/img]
Field's relics can be found in the map during the run, also dropped from the "Elite monster",
These relics will follow hero around the map and giving a huge bonus stats, However, It slowly decays when the hero is attacked but don't worry a banana could fix that. ( We don't know why but it does! )

[b]Tips to survive land of the chaos[/b]
[list]
[*] Try all weapons, Every weapon has its own strength.
[*] Manage your stamina, Dodge-roll is your best friend, Keeps at least 1 stamina point as your last resort!
[*] Always use magic weapon, magic weapon is the best way to clear a large enemy mobs. By holding "Aim" button, you can walk freely while summoning. 
[/list]
This is just the beginning~! We hope you would join us on our journey.
[b]See you on April 28th![/b]
